Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained throughput degradation detected for embeddings service in us-central (p95 tokenize+embed > 900ms, ingestion backlog growing). alert_id=embed-throughput-1796001234
Priya K: picking this up. I'm seeing increased system io wait on embedding hosts and many long-running tokenization jobs.
Devon H: I see a big spike in a single customer (cust-901) sending large batch-embed requests every 10s. Request sizes ~50k tokens each.
Sam R: that's going to saturate the CPU and NVMe I/O on the shard. Any prior rate limits? We have per-api-key burst limits but not per-tenant concurrent limits for embeddings.
Priya K: temporarily throttling requests from cust-901 now via infra token-rate limiter. Applying soft 429 with Retry-After 10s so clients back off gracefully.
Support Bot: Auto-update: Throttle policy applied to api_key=cust-901-key, action=soft-throttle, rate=5rps, timestamp=1796001305
Maya (CSE): alert from cust-901 via support channel: "We're seeing delayed embeddings, failing downstream ranking." They've got an active batch job for nightly indexing.
Devon H: mitigation plan: 1) throttle noisy tenant (done), 2) spin up 3 extra embed workers with higher IOQ and larger token buffer, 3) route non-critical low-cost embedding model (embed-fast) to best-effort customers while keeping premium model for committed customers.
Priya K: starting node add for embed-pool-us-central:```bash
./infra/pool-scale --pool embed-pool-us-central --add 3 --type io-optimized
Scaling job 9012 queued -> nodes provisioning
```

- ingest backlog: 12k pending
- average embed size: 42k tokens
- cpu_iowait: 28%
post-throttle (2m):
